mailLog.title: Email log
mailLog.sub: When it was sent and when it was read · failed emails alert the Super Admin

push.denied: The browser blocked notifications · allow them in the site settings
push.turnedOn: Notifications turned on for this device
push.turnedOff: Notifications turned off for this device
push.testFailed: The notification didn't arrive · try turning it off and on again
push.testSent: Sent · it will show on the device in a few seconds
push.title: Mobile notifications (Push)
push.sub: Notifications reach your phone or computer even when the system is closed
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications · on iPhone, add the system to the Home Screen first (Add to Home Screen).
push.offServer: Push isn't enabled on the server yet.
push.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser settings · allow them and come back here.
push.turnOn: Turn on notifications for this device

from.title: Sending email
from.sub: The server and address every notification is sent from
from.label: Sending email (From)
from.testSent: A test email was sent from {from} to {to}
from.passwordSaved: Saved · type a new one only to change it
from.gmailNote: Gmail doesn't accept the account's normal password. In the Google account → Security → turn on 2-Step Verification → App passwords → create one and paste it here (16 letters). The sending email must be that account or an address added to it.
from.outlookNote: Outlook / Microsoft 365: create an App Password in the Microsoft account's security settings; a Microsoft 365 admin must also turn on "SMTP AUTH" for this mailbox.

source.page: Emails go out through the server below
source.env: Emails still go out through the server settings (.env) · save here to manage them from this page
source.none: No mail server yet · emails aren't going out

from.superOnly: Only the Super Admin can change this

prefs.title: My preferences
prefs.note: Important notifications (Alarm / lead pulled / 5th Excuse) always go by email too, and stay until they're read.

rules.title: Notification rules
rules.sub: Who each event goes to: in the system and/or Push and/or email
rules.pushNote: Push reaches every phone or computer whose owner turned on notifications from «My account».
